theme: 科技与现代社会现象反思 (Science, Technology & Social Reflection)
description: 考研英语一高频热点母题——智能手机依赖、低头族现象、数字生活双刃剑、信息茧房与人际疏离深度论据素材库

sub_themes.name: 手机依赖与低头族现象 (Smartphone Addiction & Phubbing)

core_vocabulary.meaning: 低头族现象（因看手机而冷落他人）
core_vocabulary.collocation: the widespread prevalence of phubbing (低头族现象的蔓延)
be trapped in the heads-down generation (受困于低头族一代)
liberate oneself from digital bondage (从数字束缚中解脱)
trigger profound interpersonal alienation (引发深刻的人际疏离)
be captivated by virtual illusions (被虚拟幻象所吸引)
supplant genuine face-to-face communication (取代真诚的面对面沟通)

core_vocabulary.meaning: 数字排毒（减少使用电子产品）
core_vocabulary.collocation: embark on a periodic digital detox (进行定期的数字排毒)

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: Technology is a useful servant but a dangerous master.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: Christian Lous Lange (克里斯蒂安·朗格，诺贝尔奖得主)
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 科技是有用的仆人，却也是危险的主子。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 最经典的科技双刃剑金句，用于论述人被科技控制的风险

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: We are increasingly connected in the virtual sphere, yet emotionally isolated in the real world.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: Sherry Turkle (雪莉·特克尔《群体性孤独》)
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 我们在虚拟领域联结日益紧密，却在现实世界中陷入情感孤独。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 用于分析手机普及导致的情感疏离与聚会冷场

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: The ultimate promise of technology is to bring people closer, but ironically it often builds invisible walls between hearts.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: Contemporary Commentary
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 科技的终极承诺是拉近彼此距离，讽刺的是，它却常在心灵之间筑起无形的隔阂高墙。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 用于第二段阐述科技与人际关系的讽刺反差

argument_points.point_en: Although digital gadgets bridge geographical gulfs with unprecedented efficiency, excessive immersion in glowing screens severely erodes empathy and authentic emotional intimacy.
argument_points.point_cn: 尽管数字设备以前所未有的效率弥合了地理鸿沟，但过度沉溺于发光的屏幕却严重侵蚀了同理心与真实的情感亲密度。

argument_points.point_en: When dining tables turn into digital battlegrounds where everyone gazes at luminous rectangles, physical presence degenerates into spiritual absence.
argument_points.point_cn: 当聚餐长桌演变为人人都低头凝视发光矩形的数字孤岛，物理上的在场便蜕变为了精神上的缺席。

sample_sentence_patterns: So addicted are some individuals to their glowing screens that they turn a blind eye to the genuine warmth of companions seated right across the table.
It is high time that we broke away from the invisible shackles of digital addiction and reclaimed the invaluable warmth of authentic human fellowship.

sub_themes.name: 信息过载与碎片化阅读 (Information Overload & Fragmented Reading)

core_vocabulary.collocation: suffer from severe information overload (承受严重的信息过载)
the proliferation of fragmented reading (碎片化阅读的泛滥)
be confined within an algorithmic echo chamber (受困于算法信息茧房)
substitute fleeting impulses for in-depth contemplation (以短暂冲动替代深度沉思)
diminish our sustained attention span (缩短我们的专注时间)
degenerate into superficial consumption (沦为浅层消费)

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: A wealth of information creates a poverty of attention.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: Herbert A. Simon (赫伯特·西蒙，诺贝尔经济学奖得主)
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 信息的繁复丰富导致了注意力的极度匮乏。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 用于分析信息爆炸对深度阅读和思考能力的破坏

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: Reading furnishes the mind only with materials of knowledge; it is thinking that makes what we read ours.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: John Locke (约翰·洛克)
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 阅读仅为心智提供知识的原料；唯有沉思方能将所读化为己有。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 用于批判走马观花式的浅层浏览，倡导深度精读

argument_points.point_en: Skimming superficial snippets across digital platforms delivers immediate sensory dopamine, but it fatally undermines the cognitive capacity for structured and critical reasoning.
argument_points.point_cn: 在数字平台上浏览碎片化信息固然带来即时的感官多巴胺，却致命地损害了进行结构化与批判性思考的认知能力。

argument_points.point_en: Quantity of accumulated information does not automatically translate into wisdom; true enlightenment demands focused reading and reflective digestion.
argument_points.point_cn: 信息囤积的数量并不会自然转化为智慧；真正的通达离不开专注的研读与反思沉淀。

sample_sentence_patterns: Rather than being dazzled by the torrential deluge of online trivia, modern readers ought to anchor themselves in classic literature and quiet contemplation.
What truly enriches the human intellect is not the breadth of superficial skimming, but the depth of rigorous reflection.
